P094.authors: B Peng, Z Li, X He, L Xu
P094.label: Peng等（2025）

complete_examples.text: The elastic support block (ESB) track system, technically designated as the “low-vibration track,” represents a critical configuration within modern ballastless track architectures, retaining stratified isolation principles akin to slab-type ballastless systems.

The ESB (Elastic Support Block) ballastless track system demonstrates dual functionality in vibration/noise mitigation and structural maintenance optimization, while simultaneously enhancing track elasticity through its engineered configuration.
